state_boundary: connector readiness records are setup evidence, not live integration proof

connector_targets.name: ION Custom GPT Action Gateway
connector_targets.secret_handling: Token is configured in the Custom GPT builder auth field and local gateway env only; never paste it into chat or commit it.
read_capabilities: read queue/status/receipt surfaces when explicitly requested
write_capabilities: submit approved bounded action packets with idempotency key and operator approval evidence
connector_targets.authority_boundary: Custom GPT tool visibility is not permission; production, live execution, deployment, broad filesystem, and secret access remain refused.
proof_gates: GPT Builder imports openapi.yaml without schema errors
ionGatewayDaimonVisibility returns current dAimon proof status
mutating submit remains blocked without explicit approval evidence
connector_targets.next_gate: Keep ionGatewayDaimonVisibility as the default dAimon Companion action; expand next with GitLab read-only readiness rather than MCP JSON-RPC mutation paths.
non_claims: This does not grant the Custom GPT arbitrary local PC access.
This does not expose secrets or environment files.
This does not make Custom GPT output accepted dAimon state.

connector_targets.name: GitLab
connector_targets.secret_handling: Use a GitLab project access token or personal access token with least privilege. Store it in ignored .env or CI secrets only.
read_capabilities: read security and code review evidence when scopes allow
write_capabilities: create candidate issues or comments after explicit approval
attach dAimon receipt links to GitLab artifacts after review gates
connector_targets.authority_boundary: GitLab reads can become witness evidence; comments/issues/MR edits remain candidate SDLC actions until CI, review, and receipt gates settle them.
proof_gates: issue/MR fixture maps into continuity objects
CI/security status is cited in a receipt candidate
write mutation remains disabled until operator approval
connector_targets.next_gate: Add GITLAB_BASE_URL, GITLAB_PROJECT_ID, and a read-only GITLAB_TOKEN locally, then run a read-only GitLab readiness probe.
non_claims: Live GitLab integration is not implemented yet.
dAimon does not replace human code review, CI, security approval, or merge authority.
GitLab token values must not be pasted into chat.

connector_targets.name: Arize Phoenix
connector_targets.secret_handling: Phoenix keys stay in ignored .env or CI secrets only.
read_capabilities: inspect run trace receipts once emitted
write_capabilities: emit OpenTelemetry/OpenInference spans for dAimon runs
connector_targets.authority_boundary: Observability evidence explains behavior but does not settle truth or inheritance.
proof_gates: trace receipt links model calls, retrieval, and settlement decision
connector_targets.next_gate: Run scripts/check_phoenix_readiness.py and attach a trace receipt to a live dAimon run.
non_claims: Live Arize/Phoenix tracing is not part of the primary contest proof unless a trace receipt exists.
Trace visibility is not accepted state.

connector_targets.name: Elastic
connector_targets.secret_handling: Elastic API keys stay in ignored .env or CI secrets only.
read_capabilities: retrieve rejected/deferred witness objects without inheriting them
connector_targets.authority_boundary: Search discovers evidence; settlement decides whether the evidence changes inheritance.
connector_targets.next_gate: Add a local Elastic adapter manifest fixture for receipt/evidence search.
non_claims: Live Elastic integration is not implemented.
Search relevance is not proof of truth.
